snippet.title: Cosmolace – 15s Teaser | Indie Live Expo 2025
snippet.description:
🟣 INDIE Live Expo 2025.4.13 now is streaming!
🎥 Watch the livestream here: @indieliveexpo 

🟢 Indie Live Expo Sale is now live on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38794803/sale/INDIELiveExpo2025

✨ Cosmolace Demo is now available!
A puzzle game where perspective is everything.

Cosmolace combines optical illusions with one-stroke puzzles in 3D space.
Shift your perspective, align the impossible, and reshape the stars.

🎮 Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413210/_Cosmolace
🧩 Add to your wishlist & follow for updates!
